description: Scroll events in Svelte, Vue and React: one per moved scroller in the rendering step after the action, at the scroller only (scroll does not bubble: the wrapper's listener never runs); content that shrinks clamps the scroll position in layout, and its scroll event follows in the rendering step after the next frame; a layout read after the DOM update (forced layout) sees the clamped position at once; growing the content keeps the position (no event)
